issues.description: The problem statement and the solution disagree about the type of the Animal.name attribute: the UML in problem_statement.md declares name: String, while the textual instructions explicitly require using StringBuilder for the name attribute. The reference solution (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java) implements name as a String (private String name). This inconsistency leaves students unsure which type to use (String vs StringBuilder) and causes the solution to contradict the textual requirement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the expected attribute type consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement UML to show name: StringBuilder and adapt examples/tests to expect a StringBuilder-based implementation (and update the solution accordingly), or (B) remove the StringBuilder requirement from the textual instructions and keep name as String (update the text to instruct use of String). Ensure the reference solution matches the chosen specification and clarify whether getters/setters should expose StringBuilder or String.
